extracted.intended_audience: life scientists seeking funding and meeting organisers (Europe and beyond)
extracted.subtask_description: A high-level overview of EMBO's funding programmes and support for life scientists and meeting organisers, including fellowships, grants, travel/childcare/accessibility support, courses and events funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding for research careers
rubrics_metrics.description: EMBO provides support for the life sciences in Europe and beyond. We fund researchers as well as conferences, training and networking activities to help create an environment in which scientists can excel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic goal: support researchers and create an environment for scientific excellence; geographic emphasis: Europe and beyond.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowships, grants and career support
rubrics_metrics.description: We support outstanding life scientists at all career stages in Europe and around the world. Awardees benefit from funding, career development support and networking opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target: 'outstanding life scientists' across career stages; components: funding, career development, networking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: Postdoctoral Fellowships (listed as a core EMBO funding programme).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offered as part of EMBO's career support portfolio for postdoctoral researchers; no detailed eligibility or selection criteria are given on this overview page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific Exchange Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Scientific Exchange Grants (listed among EMBO funding options).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programme intended to support scientific exchange; specific guidance and criteria not provided on this summary page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Young Investigator Programme
rubrics_metrics.description: Young Investigator Programme (listed as an EMBO programme).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aimed at early-career investigators; details and selection requirements are available on programme-specific pages rather than this overview.

rubrics_metrics.name: Installation Grants
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to support researchers establishing independent groups; exact eligibility/requirements not specified in this overview.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global Investigator Network
rubrics_metrics.description: Global Investigator Network (listed programme to support investigators globally).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of EMBO's global activities; further specifics are on the programme pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maria Leptin | EMBO Science Journalism Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: Maria Leptin | EMBO Science Journalism Fellowships (listed as a named fellowship).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A specific fellowship addressing science journalism; overview page lists it among funding opportunities without detailed selection criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding for conferences and training
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide funding and support for scientific meetings across all disciplines in the life sciences, including workshops, practical courses, lecture courses and series as well as keynote lectures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scope: conferences and training across life-science disciplines; supported event types explicitly include workshops, practical courses, lecture courses/series and keynote lectures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lecture, travel and childcare grants (including travel grants and fee waivers)
rubrics_metrics.description: We offer funding for meeting organizers to invite speakers and to cover childcare costs of speakers and participants. Travel grants to attend meetings and fee waivers are available for participants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supported costs include speaker invitations, childcare for speakers/participants, travel grants for attendees and registration fee waivers; intended to increase participation and accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Childcare grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Childcare grants (listed as a specific support option).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to cover childcare costs for speakers and participants at meetings; part of measures to support inclusive participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Accessibility grants (listed among participant support options).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to improve accessibility of events for participants with specific needs; details are on programme-specific pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conferences & training — Courses & Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: All EMBO events including Courses & Workshops: knowledge exchange and training in new techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EMBO runs and funds courses and workshops focused on techniques and skills transfer; also includes joint events organised with partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: EMBO Lab Leadership Courses
rubrics_metrics.description: EMBO Lab Leadership Courses: Leadership, communication, scientific writing, research integrity and other professional and soft skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmes aim to train lab leaders in both scientific and professional/soft skills; part of EMBO's career development offerings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable conferencing
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustainable conferencing: Measures to reduce the environmental impact of in-person meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EMBO encourages and implements measures to make conferences more sustainable; this is a policy/operational desideratum for funded events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint events
rubrics_metrics.description: Joint events (events organized together with partners).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EMBO supports or co-organises events alongside partners; these are listed as a category of events eligible for EMBO involvement.
